constructive_source_contract_feasibility.interpretation: Frozen Stage13 is attainable by a source-silhouette-derived carrier even though the original FBX hard raster does not match the anti-aliased admitted source mask at P999.

exact_retained_summary.interpretation: Physical FBX pixel-center raster is a strict subset of the admitted source foreground; it is not an upper bound on source-raster fidelity.

purpose: Separate physical FBX hard-raster convention from source-raster fidelity authority before IRIS V4.3 TP64.

spatial_proxy_for_unretained_truth_masks.limitation: The exact historical per-pixel hard truth raster mask was not retained in the current artifact set, so hole/interior/edge values below are reference estimates, not canonical exact truth Stage13 results.
spatial_proxy_for_unretained_truth_masks.method: Use admitted source PNG alpha>=128 as a near-exact spatial proxy for the unretained hard truth raster mask; compare against known exact truth-raster pixel counts.
spatial_proxy_for_unretained_truth_masks.why_reasonable: Source binary mask equals alpha>0. Alpha>=128 reproduces retained hard-raster counts within 0..13 pixels per 1024^2 view; threshold 127..129 sensitivity is small for Stage13 hole/interior metrics.

v43_implication.primary: Close source-certified exterior violations on the exact canonical R512 MC lattice and confine residual excess to hull-boundary-crossing cells.
v43_implication.recall_hole_followup: If exterior lattice closure succeeds while source-raster recall/hole/contour remains open, authorize canonical-MC-lattice-coupled differentiable source projection/raster supervision.
